title.en: Budget sheet with a live total

prompt: This folder contains expenses.csv. Create budget.xlsx with the expenses on a sheet named "Budget": columns Category and Amount, one row per expense, followed by a row labelled "Total". The total must be calculated by a spreadsheet formula, not typed in as a number, so it updates if an amount changes.

checks.en: budget.xlsx opens as a workbook with a sheet named Budget
checks.zh: budget.xlsx 可以作为工作簿打开，且有名为 Budget 的工作表

checks.en: All eight expense categories appear with their amounts as numbers
checks.zh: 8 个支出类别全部出现，金额为数值

checks.en: A Total row exists and its amount cell is a SUM formula over the amount cells
checks.zh: 存在 Total 行，金额单元格是对金额列求和的 SUM 公式
